WITH account_totals AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        SUM(t.amount) AS account_sum,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
regional_totals AS (
    SELECT region, SUM(account_sum) AS region_total
    FROM account_totals
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
    at.account_id,
    at.region,
    at.account_sum,
    at.transaction_count,
    at.account_sum * 1.0 / NULLIF(rt.region_total, 0) AS share
FROM account_totals AS at
JOIN regional_totals AS rt ON rt.region = at.region
ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The share uses each account's sum of stored transaction amounts divided by the sum of those account sums within its region; amounts are summed unsigned as requested, without adjusting for transaction direction.
